text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a soft routing swap for eu-west -> eu-edge-b tonight during the low window (22:00 UTC). Starting at 5% for 10m then step to 20% then 40% over 30m. Need deploy owner, smoke checks, and rollback readiness.

maria: I can own smoke checks + quick perf/latency validation. I'll be online at 21:45 UTC.

rahul: I'll run the deployment (will trigger the route weight change). Oncall until 23:30. Ping me in thread when ready to cut.

sam: Can you paste the exact commands we'll run for smoke + rollback? I want to script the checks.

alex: Good call. Smoke checklist (short):
1) API connectivity from eu-edge: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.edge.eu/status | jq .` should return 200 and healthy.
2) Latency quick check: `hey -n 100 -c 10 https://api.redwood.edge.eu/predict` expect p50 < 120ms.
3) KV cache hit sanity: grep logs for `kvcache.hit_rate` not dropping > 5% from baseline.
4) Error spike: check SLO error-rate for 5m window in dashboard (alerts off if > 1%).

Quick commands for ops (example):
```
# set weight to 5%
rwctl route set-weight --region eu-west --target eu-edge-b --weight 5
# increase to 20%
rwctl route set-weight --region eu-west --target eu-edge-b --weight 20
# rollback to 0% (if needed)
rwctl route set-weight --region eu-west --target eu-edge-b --weight 0
```

jessie: DNS TTL for eu-edge-b currently 300s. We should lower to 60s 2 hours before the cut to speed rollback if needed. Do we want ops-infra to make that change?

rahul: Good catch. I can ask infra to lower TTL at 20:00 UTC. Will post when done.

maria: For smoke I will run the `hey` latency run + open a quick Kibana dashboard with a 15m window. I'll post the p50/p95 and error counts after each step.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/region-weight-shift/eu-west -> eu-edge-b scheduled by rahul at 22:00 UTC. CI checks passed.

sam: One more q — are we using the canary model variant or same model instance? Need to know for regression checks.

alex: Same model variant; just routing policy change (no model swap). So main regression risk is infra (latency, cache behavior), not output diffs.

jessie: FYI I created a tiny runbook snippet in docs: /runbooks/edge-routing-soft-swap (added check items + rollback commands).

rahul: I'll annotate the deploy with timestamps and change reasons. If anything looks off we rollback to 0% and call for a live huddle.

maria: I'll post smoke results at 22:05, 22:20, 22:40 as we step. If p95 jumps > 200ms or errors > 1% we rollback.

alex: Great. Final checklist: TTL lowered (jessie), deploy owner (rahul), smoke (maria), rollback command ready (sam). Meeting-free unless we hit rollback. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: I'll standby and have the rollback CLI ready. :eyes:

ops-bot: Reminder: please acknowledge in thread when you finish preflight.

maria: Preflight done (21:50 UTC) — dashboards open, baseline captured.

rahul: TTL lowered confirmed (20:05 UTC). Ready to deploy.

alex: Perfect — will kick the window at 22:00 UTC. Good luck and reach out if anything unusual.

jessie: GL all :rocket:
